description: Removes the constant offset from two signals, each polyphonic

params.text: Sets the length of the filter in samples: 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 or 128, with shorter lengths filtering more of the low end away; the top setting, marked 256, uses a plain one-pole blocker instead

inputs.text: The signal for the left channel, filtered out to the jack marked OutL
The signal for the right channel, filtered out to the jack marked OutR

outputs.text: The left signal with its offset removed, despite the maker's tooltip on this jack reading In L
The right signal with its offset removed

notes: the two sides are separate and nothing is normalled between them, so a signal patched into InL alone leaves OutR silent
